routes.difficulty: Needs a few things to break right
routes.likelihood_text: This stretch comes through in about 12 out of 100 simulated seasons.
routes.rival_note: Vic is pulling the other way on Mississippi State.
routes.narrative: The awkward part: John benefits when Mississippi State has a bad Saturday. A close escape still counts as a win, so ugly football alone will not do the job. This particular route asks for a clean sweep; one wrong result breaks the streak, though other paths remain.
routes.banter: John has been explaining football to this family for years. Mississippi State could save everyone a lengthy clarification by following the plan.
routes.if_it_happens: If this stretch lands, John has a stronger title case and Vic will have been cheering against the very same results.

title_routes.method: Possible routes, not a checklist that guarantees a title. Other games still matter. Scenarios use the next four games (or fewer if the season is ending), shared game results, fixed ratings, and equal shares for tied titles.

schedule_watch.summary: Changes in opponent strength are reshaping the road ahead.
schedule_watch.method: Same remaining opponents and venues, picked team held at its draft SP+ rating. Only opponent ratings change. Unrated opponents are excluded; coverage is shown. This measures schedule change, not total team improvement.
